top_signals.title: The AI Boom Hits the Bond Market
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan’s Gabriela Santos says AI remains the biggest theme in global markets—but investors may be dangerously concentrated. She explains why recurring AI selloffs are inevitable, where investors can still find diversification, and how massive tech borrowing is quietly extending AI risk from stocks into bonds. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Canadian Stocks Climb as Trump Pauses Tariffs, Signals Deal Near
top_signals.summary: Canadian equities jumped in early trading Wednesday after US President Donald Trump said he would delay new 50% tariffs for three days and added that that two sides were close to a trade deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dollar Tumbles as Treasury Buyback Unleashes Bond-Market Rally
top_signals.summary: The dollar tumbled by the most in three weeks to its weakest level since mid-May after the bond market rallied on the US Treasury Department’s unexpected announcement that it is increasing buybacks of long-dated bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Record Pace of Bond Sales Jolts Europe Out of Summer Lull
top_signals.summary: Bond sales in Europe are roaring back from the summer lull at the fastest pace on record, resuming the breakneck pace of borrowing seen globally throughout the year.

top_signals.title: MacGregor Share Q2 2026 Interim Report
